summary: This README describes the Nav2 Map Server, which supplies maps to the rest of the Nav2 system through topic and service interfaces. It covers the architecture (map_server, map_saver, and the map_io library), command-line usage with YAML map files and ROS2 parameters, the map_saver_cli tool, the supported occupancy grid map type, and the load_map and save_map services with example calls.
one_line: Nav2 Map Server README covering its architecture, parameter-based map loading, map saving, the map_io library, and load/save map services.
key_facts: The Nav2 Map Server provides maps to the rest of the Nav2 system using both topic and service interfaces.
The Nav2 map server divides into three parts: map_server, map_saver, and the map_io library.
The map_server component is responsible for loading a map from a file through the command-line interface or service requests.
The map_io library is designed to be object-independent so it can save and load maps from external code by calling its functions.
The map_io library currently contains OccupancyGrid saving and loading functions moved from the rest of the map server code.
The Nav2 map server retains the map YAML file format from ROS1 Nav1 but uses the ROS2 parameter mechanism to get the YAML filename, specified by the yaml_filename parameter.
The yaml_filename parameter must be set for the initial map, but an empty string can be used if no initial map should be loaded.
In ROS1, the map_saver tool was renamed to map_saver_cli in Nav2 and is invoked with ros2 run nav2_map_server map_saver_cli.
The only currently supported map type is Occupancy grid (nav_msgs/msg/OccupancyGrid).
The map_server node provides a "map" service to get the map, described in the nav_msgs/srv/GetMap.srv file.
NEW in ROS2 Eloquent, map_server provides a "load_map" service and map_saver provides a "save_map" service, defined in nav2_msgs/srv/LoadMap.srv and nav2_msgs/srv/SaveMap.srv.
To use the load_map and save_map services, map_server or map_saver should be launched as a continuously running nav2::LifecycleNode.
The nav2_map_server/launch/map_saver_server.launch.py launch file can be used to run Map Saver in server mode.
The MapIO library API in map_io.hpp includes loadMapYaml(), loadMapFromFile(), loadMapFromYaml(), and saveMapToFile().

entities.name: Map Server
entities.role: Composable ROS2 node that provides maps to the rest of the Nav2 system via topic and service interfaces

entities.name: map_server
entities.role: Architecture component responsible for loading the map from a file via command line or service requests; default executable instancing the Map Server node

entities.name: map_saver
entities.role: Architecture component that saves the map into a file via command line or the save_map service

entities.name: map_io
entities.role: Map input-output library used by map_loader and map_saver, containing OccupancyGrid saving/loading functions

entities.name: map_saver_cli
entities.role: Command-line executable name for map_saver, renamed from map_saver in Nav2

entities.name: ROS1 navigation map server
entities.role: Original map server in ROS1 navigation, whose YAML format and command-line usage Nav2 partly retains

entities.name: load_map
entities.role: Service provided by map_server to load and publish a map at run-time, defined in nav2_msgs/srv/LoadMap.srv

entities.name: save_map
entities.role: Service provided by map_saver to save the map to a file, defined in nav2_msgs/srv/SaveMap.srv

entities.name: map
entities.role: Service provided by map_server to get the map, defined in nav_msgs/srv/GetMap.srv

entities.name: map_saver_server.launch.py
entities.role: Launch file in nav2_map_server/launch used to run Map Saver in server mode

entities.name: ROS2 Eloquent
entities.role: ROS2 release in which the load_map and save_map services were introduced

entities.name: nav2::LifecycleNode
entities.role: Node type in which map_server or map_saver must run to use the load and save services
